messages:
alex: Short follow-up from the postmortem  we need owners + tiny ETAs for the streaming reliability actions (timeouts, partial chunks, reconnect storms). I'll collect for the retro packet.

priya: I can own client retry guidance + SDK defaults. Plan: set maxRetries=3, baseBackoff=500ms, cap=5s, jitter +/-20%. ETA: Tue. Ticket RW-7201.

dan: I'll own server-side graceful eviction and session write backpressure. Quick change: soft-evict threshold + 10s grace window. ETA: Thu EOD. Ticket RW-7202.

kate: I'll build the "silent partial" detector and a dashboard tile. Detector: emit event when inter-chunk gap > 7s w/o error. ETA: Wed AM. Ticket RW-7203.

alex: Fast remediations this week? Increase heartbeat from 20s->12s for affected fleets, enable ephemeral replication for hot ranges, and add canary gate checking chunk-gap p90. Who picks which?

priya: Devex will ship SDK sample + doc change. I'll draft PR and samples.

dan: Infra toggle for replication = mine. Will push a toggle and rollout plan. ETA: Tue morning. RW-7204.

kate: I'll add canary gate doc & a short runbook entry for abort thresholds. ETA: Wed. RW-7205.

monitor-bot: Tickets created: RW-7201 (priya) https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-7201, RW-7202 (dan) https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-7202, RW-7203 (kate) https://tracker.redwood.ai/RW-7203

alex: Checklist for retro summary: - SDK retry defaults: priya  RW-7201  Tue - Eviction/backpressure: dan  RW-7202  Thu EOD - Silent partial detector: kate  RW-7203  Wed AM - Replication toggle (fast rem): dan  RW-7204  Tue AM - Canary gate + runbook: kate  RW-7205  Wed

priya: :white_check_mark: Will include sample code (exponential backoff snippet) in RW-7201.

dan: :white_check_mark: Scheduling infra sync for replication toggle.

kate: :white_check_mark: Will pair with SRE on alert thresholds.

alex: Great. If anything slips, post a 1-line update here so I can update the leadership note.
